name: ribbons

name: circular-gallery

name: elastic-slider

name: flowing-menu

name: flying-posters

name: folder

name: gooey-nav

name: infinite-menu
title: Infinite Menu

name: magic-bento
title: Magic Bento

name: masonry

name: model-viewer
title: Model Viewer
description: Interactive GLTF/GLB/FBX/OBJ model viewer with orbit, parallax, and hover effects.

name: pill-nav
title: Pill Nav
description: Animated pill-shaped nav with circular GSAP hover and mobile menu.

name: pixel-card
title: Pixel Card
description: Card with shimmering pixel canvas effect on hover/focus.

name: profile-card
title: Profile Card
description: Holographic profile card with pointer/device-orientation tilt and animated shine.

name: reflective-card
title: Reflective Card
description: Webcam-fed metallic glass card using SVG turbulence and specular lighting filters.

name: scroll-stack
title: Scroll Stack
description: Scroll-driven card stack with pin/scale/blur/rotation, powered by Lenis smooth-scroll.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: Card with a soft radial spotlight that follows the cursor.

name: stack
title: Stack
description: Draggable card stack with spring rotation and send-to-back interaction.

name: staggered-menu
title: Staggered Menu
description: Full-screen staggered slide-in menu with layered colors and GSAP timelines.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Animated multi-step form with sliding step content and round step indicators.

name: tilted-card
title: Tilted Card
description: 3D tilt-on-mouse card with spring physics and a cursor-following caption.

name: bell-toggle
title: Bell Toggle
description: Pill toggle that answers a press at three tempos: the bell rings on damped keyframes, the label blur-crossfades, and the pill unfurls to the longer label through a clip-path on a critically damped spring. The pressed state is the receipt.

name: branched-menu
title: Branched Menu
description: Collapsible menu whose sections unfold into a trunk with a curved branch to each child, and an accent line that travels down the trunk and around the curve to whatever you pick, while a marker glides to the open section.

name: call-chip
title: Call Chip
description: Inline tool-call chip whose fill wipes across while a live ms counter ticks, completing with a green wash on success or stopping short and shaking red with a retry glyph on error.

name: code-slots
title: Code Slots
description: One-time-code input where a hidden overlay input owns focus, paste and SMS autofill while each slot lands its digit on one spring: the fill swells from the centre, the digit rises and the caret glides; a wrong code drains the slots in a cascade, a right one merges them into a single accent wash.

name: comet-dial
title: Comet Dial
description: Tick-ring dial you flick by angle: the reading launches on a spring and a velocity-driven comet streaks behind the lit head, trailing the direction of travel and vanishing at rest.

name: dodge-field
title: Dodge Field
description: Wrapper that makes any child flee the pointer inside a bounded field, dodges once per approach, then relents after a few tries and glides home.

name: flip-card
title: Flip Card
description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, a drag or a flick, settling on a spring that carries your release velocity, with an optional cursor tilt, a sheen that follows the pointer and a shadow that narrows as it turns edge on.

name: folder-float
title: Folder Float
description: Folder that opens on hover or press: the flap tilts toward you, a paper edge rises, and its notes spring out from behind the flap into a floating cloud to pick from, then sink back when the folder closes.

name: fuse-button
title: Fuse Button
description: Action button whose done state carries its own undo on a burning fuse: press, the label crossfades to Undo, a hairline burns for the undo window, and Undo or Escape runs it back.

name: glide-select
title: Glide Select
description: Select chip whose menu pops out of its own corner and whose single hover highlight glides between rows, remembering where you left it so re-entry slides from there instead of blinking in.

name: hold-button
title: Hold Button
description: Hold-to-confirm button whose liquid fill rises while pressed, snaps back on an early release and swaps its label through a blur when the hold completes.

name: jelly-radio
title: Jelly Radio
description: Radio group of labelled chips where the chosen one swells wide-then-tall on two springs and barges its neighbours outward with a travelling stagger, so a selection reads as a force moving through the row.

name: lattice-loader
title: Lattice Loader
description: Inline agent-status row: a 3x3 or 4x4 lattice whose cells brighten in a phase-offset wave beside a verb and a live stopwatch, resolving into a check or a cross when the task ends.

name: paper-crumple
title: Paper Crumple
description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while held and follows the grabbed point as you drag. Release it as a crumpled ball, unfold it flat, or leave the paper creased, with customizable folds, paper grain, lighting and shadows.

name: peek-rating
title: Peek Rating
description: Star rating you can try before you commit: sweeping the row lifts a trailing wave of stars up to the pointer while a tip hops along with the label; a click commits with a pop.

name: prompt-bar
title: Prompt Bar
description: Chat composer with an @ sources menu, a / commands menu, a model picker, dictation and attachments, whose send tile charges to ink the moment there is something to send and morphs its arrow into a stop square while busy.

name: pulse-heart
title: Pulse Heart
description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour at its smallest frame and pulses back while the count swaps one glyph.

name: refine-frame
title: Refine Frame
description: Reserved-aspect frame that walks any media through queued, generating, refining and complete without layout shift: each stage is one blur, saturate, scale and opacity tween, a soft band sweeps while it works, a chip reports the stage, and an error dims the picture behind a retry pill.

name: rubber-segment
title: Rubber Segment
description: Segmented control with a rubber thumb: taps stretch it across the gap and squash it onto the target, and you can grab, drag and flick it between slots.

name: scrub-field
title: Scrub Field
description: Number chip you drag to scrub: the value follows the hand, pushes past the range on a rubber band, and a click without moving opens it for typing.

name: slide-commit
title: Slide Commit
description: Slide-to-confirm handle that plants with a spinner while your action runs, unfurls into a done pill on success and springs home with a squash and shake on failure.

name: sling-button
title: Sling Button
description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot: the band stretches, a power arc arms it, and releasing fires the action with the flick's velocity.

name: slosh-gauge
title: Slosh Gauge
description: Tank gauge whose liquid chases the value with mass, tilts with its own speed and splashes against the top when it slams full; optionally a vertical slider.

name: spring-check
title: Spring Check
description: Checkbox row where a single spring fills the box, draws the tick, strikes the label and dims the words in one press.

name: squish-switch
title: Squish Switch
description: Drag-scrubbable switch whose thumb stretches by how fast it moves, flips at the midpoint and squashes against the track end on a flick.

name: status-mark
title: Status Mark
description: A 20px status glyph for agent task lists that morphs in place from a dashed idle ring to a spinning or real-progress arc, then draws a check or a cross, with an optional label strike.

name: swipe-row
title: Swipe Row
description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions, snaps by flick velocity, and deletes on a full swipe that stretches the action colour across the row.

name: swipe-toast
title: Swipe Toast
description: Single toast that rises through its bottom edge, swipes down to dismiss on a flick or a distance, and burns a thin fuse for exactly its remaining time; hover pauses it and an inline mode keeps it inside any container.

name: tear-ticket
title: Tear Ticket
description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand: paper bridges stretch into fibres and snap one by one from the far end, the torn edges are jagged and fit each other, the freed stub dangles and drops, and the body is stamped as used. The artwork tilts in 3D with parallax on hover.

name: thought-line
title: Thought Line
description: Reasoning-trace header: a glyph and a label breathe beside a live clock while steps appear beneath, then the line settles on one beat into "Thought for 4.2s" through a blur crossfade and the trace folds into it.

name: voice-pill
title: Voice Pill
description: Mic button that swells into a tinted capsule of level-driven equalizer bars and an elapsed clock while held or toggled, then relaxes back into the mic on release; simulated voice by default, real microphone as an opt-in.

name: wake-slider
title: Wake Slider
description: Range slider drawn as thin bars with no thumb: drag speed raises a wake that trails behind the handle and flattens again at rest.

name: warm-tooltip
title: Warm Tooltip
description: Tooltip group with one shared delay: the first label waits and pops from its trigger, then siblings open instantly while the group is warm, with an optional velocity lean.

name: ascii-text
title: ASCII Text
description: Renders text with an animated ASCII background for a retro feel.

name: blur-text
title: Blur Text
description: Per-word/letter blur-in animation triggered when scrolled into view, with configurable direction, easing and stepped keyframes.

name: circular-text
title: Circular Text
description: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

name: count-up
title: Count Up
description: Spring-animated number counter that counts up (or down) when scrolled into view, with configurable spring physics, delay, and number formatting.

name: curved-loop
title: Curved Loop
description: Marquee text rendered along a curved SVG path that scrolls infinitely and can be dragged for interactive control.

name: decrypted-text
title: Decrypted Text
description: Scrambled-character reveal effect that decrypts a string on hover, click, or scroll-into-view, with sequential or random iteration modes.

name: falling-text
title: Falling Text
description: Characters fall with gravity + bounce creating a playful entrance.

name: fuzzy-text
title: Fuzzy Text
description: Canvas-rendered text that displaces pixel rows or columns on every frame to create a fuzzy/static distortion, with hover, click, and glitch modes.

name: glitch-text
title: Glitch Text
description: RGB-split glitch effect on text using clip-path keyframe animation, with optional hover-only mode.

name: gradient-text
title: Gradient Text
description: Animated multi-color gradient text with optional border, direction, yoyo and pause-on-hover.

name: masked-heading
title: Masked Heading
description: Masked Heading component from svelte-bits.

name: rotating-text
title: Rotating Text
description: Cycles through an array of phrases with per-character stagger animations on entry and exit, driven by motion springs.

name: scrambled-text
title: Scrambled Text
description: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

name: scroll-float
title: Scroll Float
description: Scroll-triggered floating text animation with per-character stagger.

name: scroll-reveal
title: Scroll Reveal
description: Words reveal in sequence as the container scrolls into view, with optional rotation and blur tied to the scroll position.

name: scroll-velocity
title: Scroll Velocity
description: Multi-row marquee that scrolls horizontally at a base velocity and accelerates with spring-smoothed page-scroll movement.

name: shiny-text
title: Shiny Text
description: Animated shiny gradient sweep across text, with yoyo + direction controls.

name: shuffle
title: Shuffle
description: Per-character shuffle animation: each letter slides through interim glyphs before settling on its final character, with hover replay and ScrollTrigger entrance.

name: split-text
title: Split Text
description: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.

name: text-cursor
title: Text Cursor
description: Trail of repeating text glyphs that follows the cursor, optionally rotating to match direction and floating with random keyframes.

name: text-pressure
title: Text Pressure
description: Variable-font heading where each character reacts to cursor proximity by morphing its width, weight, italic and opacity axes.

name: text-type
title: Text Type
description: Typewriter effect that types and deletes through one or more sentences with a configurable cursor, blink rate, variable speed, and color rotation.

name: true-focus
title: True Focus
description: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.

name: variable-proximity
title: Variable Proximity
description: Per-letter variable-font interpolation that responds to cursor proximity inside a container, with linear, exponential or gaussian falloff.
